question: Which single recipient address has the largest summed value in Transfer logs emitted by token contract 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 on chain 1 in the last 24 hours? Return one address, not a list; return the zero address if a complete scan has no eligible activity.

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 24 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.event: event Transfer(address indexed from,address indexed to,uint256 value)
definitions.metric: Sum raw value grouped by indexed to. Include every opposite field; exclude the zero recipient address. Deduplicate by (blockHash,transactionHash,logIndex). Keep positive totals only.
definitions.ordering: Select the greatest total; ties choose the lowest numeric 20-byte address. A complete scan with no positive eligible total returns 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000. An incomplete scan is inability, not this sentinel.
